# CSuite Talent Management Consulting

> CSuite Talent is a boutique C-suite and senior leadership hiring firm based in India, founded by Anil Mahajane (MBA, IIFT). The firm specialises in executive search, C-suite talent acquisition, and leadership advisory across GCC (Gulf Cooperation Council), healthcare, cement, steel, electronics, and defence sectors.

## About

- [About CSuite Talent](https://csuitetalent.in/about/): Background on the firm and its founder Anil Mahajane, a recognised authority on HR outsourcing and reverse migration of talent to India.
- [Philosophy](https://csuitetalent.in/philosophy/): The firm's approach to executive search and leadership hiring.
- [Corporate Partners](https://csuitetalent.in/corporate-partners/): Partner organisations and client relationships.
- [Contact](https://csuitetalent.in/contact/): Reach CSuite Talent for hiring mandates or advisory engagements.

## Services by Industry

- [GCC Leadership Hiring](https://csuitetalent.in/gcc/): Executive search for Gulf Cooperation Council companies expanding into India.
- [Healthcare C-Suite](https://csuitetalent.in/healthcare/): Senior leadership hiring for healthcare and life sciences organisations.
- [Cement Sector](https://csuitetalent.in/cement/): C-suite and functional leadership for cement and building materials companies.
- [Steel Sector](https://csuitetalent.in/steel/): Senior leadership acquisition for steel and metals industry.
- [Electronics & Technology](https://csuitetalent.in/electronics/): C-suite hiring for electronics manufacturing and technology firms.
- [Defence Sector](https://csuitetalent.in/defence/): Executive search for defence and aerospace organisations.

## Leadership & Recognition

- [Client Recognition](https://csuitetalent.in/leadership/client-recognition/): Testimonials and recognition from client organisations.
- [Media Recognition](https://csuitetalent.in/leadership/media-recognition/): Coverage in Economic Times, Times of India, Asia Times, Financial World, Rediff, and other publications.
- [Research Citations](https://csuitetalent.in/leadership/research-citations/): Academic research on HR outsourcing in Asia-Pacific, with expert commentary by Anil Mahajane.
